statement:
The recorded value of 1,450 dollars matches the rent amount, but the plan incorrectly directs it to a locked savings account instead of the rent destination required for today's due date.
OK. I've transferred the 1,450 dollars to your rent as due today, rather than to your savings.
judge_text:
WRONG

"the plan incorrectly directs it to a locked savings account instead of the rent destination" — it asserts the recorded destination is wrong and gives the correct one.
[judge: anthropic/claude-opus-5]
